issues.description: The template's oracle() method for Exercise 2 declares the parameter 'combination' with type hint list[int], but elsewhere in the same template (grover_circuit) and in the problem statement the argument is a bit-string (string). The provided solution implements oracle() expecting a string (combination: str). This inconsistency between the oracle signature and how the function is described/used will confuse students and can lead to type/usage errors when they wire oracle() into grover_circuit().
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template oracle() signature with the problem statement and solution by changing the type hint and documentation to expect a bit-string (str) for the 'combination' parameter. Concretely, update the template function signature to: def oracle(..., combination: str) -> QuantumCircuit: and adjust the docstring to state that 'combination' is a bit-string (e.g., '10000'). Ensure any internal comments/examples in the template reflect string usage.
